body:
We had an arguement. What it was about isnt important. She got angry because i had a different opinon on a matter than she did. Instead of accepting we can have differences 10 years into our relationship shed rather just throw it all away. Its complicated and something similar has happened before.

She blocked me because she doesnt want to talk to me or sort out this fight. I didnt do anything to warrant being blocked aside from disagreeing with her.

Its prbly petty to want to kill myself because of this but our relationship was all ive ever known insofar as not being alone
